subject: Run Doré Design real-work elimination
body: Run the bounded first-round real-work elimination now. OpenPencil is already terminal FAIL and must not be retried. Test Penpot, Framesmith, Doop and Tela independently. Required gate: create structured artifact, visible/renderable evidence, modify the same artifact, render/verify again. One failure must never stop later candidates. Preserve exact failure and learning evidence. No user terminal mediation. Return final PASS/FAIL matrix and 0/1/multiple-pass strategy.
